description: This Java source file defines the BinPacker class, which implements a heuristic-based 2D bin packing algorithm for rectangles, including methods for adding space, occupying space, and debugging diagnostics.

classes.name: BinPacker
classes.description: A class implementing a heuristic 2D bin packing algorithm for rectangles, with methods for adding space, occupying space, and debugging.

methods.name: addSpace
methods.description: Adds a rectangle to the available space if it meets minimum size requirements.

methods.name: occupy
methods.description: Attempts to place a rectangle of specified dimensions into the bin, returning its position if successful.

methods.name: findBest
methods.description: Finds the best available space rectangle to fit a new rectangle of given size.

methods.name: removeRect
methods.description: Removes a rectangle from the available space list efficiently by swapping with the last element.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a space rectangle into occupied and remaining sub-rectangles after placing a new rectangle.

methods.name: dumpDiagnostics
methods.description: Generates diagnostic PNG images of the current space state for debugging.

methods.name: paintDiagnostics
methods.description: Draws visual diagnostics of space rectangles and allocations.
